title: Tenma Saki — In My Empty Room〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, time to clean my room!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Hehe. I bet Ichi's gonna really like it if she comes in and sees that it's spotless.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Umm... Everything on and around my desk looks okay! Next, the bookshelves.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... I'll start by taking down all the big books!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh...
I haven't seen this album in forever. This one's from back when we were in elementary school, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is the missing second volume of that manga series. I didn't realize it was hidden away back here!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, thank goodness I found it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What was it about? Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, stop! I've gotta get my room clean before Ichi gets here!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Things that are bound to tempt me, like this manga, belong in the “I'll put you away later” pile.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I do want to read it...
And I will. After I've finished cleaning up here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's see... These are those really old children's books. And these look like songwriting references...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Something just fell out...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, huh...? My songwriting notes...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: When did I write these...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, this melody's kinda nice...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's up-tempo and has a cute sound to it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I like how things progress through the pre-chorus... It's a little weird, but also kinda fun.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This chord progression might help me with the song I've been working on!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, where's my music notebook?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Here we are!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If I throw some of these chords into the part I was working on yesterday...
One hour later

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki, how's your room coming along?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Mom was just wondering what we wanted for dinner. Anything you'd like to...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Did she not hear me just now?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, she's writing a song.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
She's hard at work.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But her room's still a mess...
Actually, I think it's messier than before.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My word...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh?! Oh, Tsukasa, it's you...
How long have you been there?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Only a moment.
Sorry for interrupting you. I know you were focusing on your work.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, what happened to cleaning your room...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? No, my room...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I totally forgot!
I was so set on cleaning it too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I'll just have to help you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, you will?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course. Things will go much faster if we're both here to clean it, no? Just give me the word!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Tsukasa!
You're a lifesaver.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Always!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Then, let's get started...!
We're gonna make my room spotless...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And Ichi and I are gonna write the best song ever!!!
